BCCI to Appoint New Head Coach and Staff for Team India

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is reportedly planning to appoint a new head coach and coaching staff for the Indian cricket team. This decision is expected to be made soon, with VVS Laxman being considered for the head coach role. The move aims to prepare the team for upcoming tours, including a series against New Zealand.
